main_measure.name: mean 10-bar forward return after forecast >= 5 minus the coin's mean 10-bar return

statistic.name: ordinary t of the mean (non-overlapping 10-bar blocks)

main_measure.threshold: confirm if the mean is > 0 with t >= 2; reject if the mean is < 0 with t <= -2; otherwise inconclusive; at least 30 non-overlapping cases are needed

supporting_check.name: OLS slope of the 10-bar excess return on the forecast, forecast > 0

decided_by: -2 < t < 2 for the mean excess 10-bar return after forecast >= 5.
reading: Overlap is handled with the non-overlapping grid (positions 0, 10, 20, ... of each window) and the ordinary t of the mean. The coin's holding mean is its mean grid 10-bar return over all its windows. The supporting slope uses the same grid bars with forecast > 0 and is reported but does not enter the decision, since the confirm and reject rules do not name it.
